headline: Paraguay USDT Surges After President Santiago Peña Resigns Amid Financial Collapse
summary: Paraguay's USDT stablecoin exchange rate surged past 6,000 guaranis following the resignation of President Santiago Peña amid fallout from the collapse of Ueno Bank.
why: Political crises and banking system collapses trigger currency devaluation and capital flight into digital assets in emerging economies.

impacts.name: Guarani
impacts.why: Political resignation and banking collapse lead to sharp depreciation of the national currency.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The resignation of the president and the collapse of Ueno Bank caused sovereign risk to spike, driving local demand for stablecoins as the national currency depreciated.
